mapper.sql: a.asset_id, a.asset_no, a.asset_nm, a.category_cd, a.brand, a.model_nm, a.serial_no, a.purchase_dt, a.purchase_amount, a.depreciation_months, a.status_cd, a.assigned_user_id, u.name AS assigned_user_name, d.dept_nm AS assigned_user_dept, a.assigned_dt, a.location, a.memo, a.created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO gw_asset (asset_no, asset_nm, category_cd, brand, model_nm, serial_no, purchase_dt, purchase_amount, depreciation_months, status_cd, assigned_user_id, assigned_dt, location, memo, created_by) VALUES (#{assetNo}, #{assetNm}, #{categoryCd}, #{brand}, #{modelNm}, #{serialNo}, #{purchaseDt}, COALESCE(#{purchaseAmount}, 0), COALESCE(#{depreciationMonths}, 36), COALESCE(#{statusCd},'IN_STOCK'), #{assignedUserId}, #{assignedDt}, #{location}, #{memo}, #{createdBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE gw_asset SET asset_nm = #{assetNm}, category_cd = #{categoryCd}, brand = #{brand}, model_nm = #{modelNm}, serial_no = #{serialNo}, purchase_dt = #{purchaseDt}, purchase_amount = #{purchaseAmount}, depreciation_months = #{depreciationMonths}, location = #{location}, memo = #{memo}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE asset_id = #{assetId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE gw_asset SET deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE asset_id = #{assetId}
UPDATE gw_asset SET assigned_user_id = #{userId}, assigned_dt = #{assignedDt}, status_cd = #{statusCd}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE asset_id = #{assetId}
UPDATE gw_asset SET status_cd = #{statusCd}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE asset_id = #{assetId}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM gw_asset a LEFT JOIN gw_user u ON u.user_id = a.assigned_user_id LEFT JOIN gw_dept d ON d.dept_id = u.dept_id WHERE a.asset_id = #{assetId} AND a.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT FROM gw_asset a LEFT JOIN gw_user u ON u.user_id = a.assigned_user_id LEFT JOIN gw_dept d ON d.dept_id = u.dept_id
ORDER BY a.asset_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gw_asset a LEFT JOIN gw_user u ON u.user_id = a.assigned_user_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO gw_asset_history (asset_id, action_cd, actor_id, target_user_id, before_status, after_status, memo) VALUES (#{assetId}, #{actionCd}, #{actorId}, #{targetUserId}, #{beforeStatus}, #{afterStatus}, #{memo})
mapper.select: SELECT h.history_id, h.asset_id, a.asset_no, h.action_cd, h.actor_id, ua.name AS actor_name, h.target_user_id, ut.name AS target_user_name, h.action_dt, h.before_status, h.after_status, h.memo FROM gw_asset_history h JOIN gw_asset a ON a.asset_id = h.asset_id LEFT JOIN gw_user ua ON ua.user_id = h.actor_id LEFT JOIN gw_user ut ON ut.user_id = h.target_user_id WHERE h.asset_id = #{assetId} ORDER BY h.action_dt DESC
SELECT status_cd AS status_cd, COUNT(*) AS cnt, COALESCE(SUM(purchase_amount), 0) AS total_amount FROM gw_asset WHERE deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY status_cd
SELECT category_cd AS category_cd, COUNT(*) AS cnt, COALESCE(SUM(purchase_amount), 0) AS total_amount FROM gw_asset WHERE deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY category_cd ORDER BY cnt DESC
